description: Estimating durations of disruptions to freight transport due to climate-related hazards is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Raghav Pant, Tom Russell (University of Oxford). A table of hazard intensity thresholds and notes on how to estimate the duration of disruption to freight transport (road and rail) due to climate-related hazards (extreme heat, flooding and tropical cyclone winds). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
